description.usage: Verify Parquet Arrow schema parity before publishing or consuming generations.

schema.name: agency_lifecycle_stats
schema.businessName: Time to final rule by agency
schema.description: Estimated days to a final rule by agency and stratum, using Aalen–Johansen cumulative incidence with withdrawal as a competing outcome and 95% intervals. Cells pool all proposal years; fewer than 30 rules suppress estimates. NULL quartiles mean the estimate never reaches that probability. Routine families exist only for FAA, EPA and USCG. Each docketed proceeding counts separately, including proposals naming several dockets. Cohort estimates require filtering and recomputing the underlying lifecycles.

properties.name: agency_code
properties.description: The agency the cell covers; NULL for all agencies together.

properties.name: stratum
properties.description: The rules counted: `all`, `routine`, `non_routine`, or one routine family.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Lifecycles in the cell with a survival outcome.

properties.name: finals
properties.description: How many of them became final.

properties.name: withdrawals
properties.description: How many of them were withdrawn.

properties.name: censored
properties.description: How many of them were still open at `censor_date`.

properties.name: suppressed
properties.description: Whether the cell has fewer than 30 rules and so carries no estimates.

properties.name: q1_days
properties.description: First day the cumulative incidence of a final reaches 25%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed.

properties.name: q1_lower_days
properties.description: Lower end of the 95% interval of `q1_days`: the first day the band's upper edge reaches 25%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed.

properties.name: q1_upper_days
properties.description: Upper end of the 95% interval of `q1_days`: the first day the band's lower edge reaches 25%; NULL where it never does.

properties.name: median_days
properties.description: First day the cumulative incidence of a final reaches 50%: the median time to final; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed.

properties.name: median_lower_days
properties.description: Lower end of the 95% interval of `median_days`: the first day the band's upper edge reaches 50%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed.

properties.name: median_upper_days
properties.description: Upper end of the 95% interval of `median_days`; NULL where the band's lower edge never reaches 50%.

properties.name: q3_days
properties.description: First day the cumulative incidence of a final reaches 75%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed.

properties.name: q3_lower_days
properties.description: Lower end of the 95% interval of `q3_days`: the first day the band's upper edge reaches 75%; NULL where it never does or the cell is suppressed.

properties.name: q3_upper_days
properties.description: Upper end of the 95% interval of `q3_days`; NULL where the band's lower edge never reaches 75%.

properties.name: censor_date
properties.description: The lifecycles' censor date, where the estimates' open rules are censored.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One agency (or all agencies) and one stratum of rules.

customProperties.value: Null agency codes represent all agencies together and are excluded. Full selected keys and unique parent keys checked on 2026-10-06; CI checks resolution and parent uniqueness.

schema.name: agenda_item_proceedings
schema.description: One row per piece of evidence that an agenda item tracks a proceeding: a docket, Regulations.gov document or Register document that directly reports the RIN for that proceeding. Unified Agenda equality alone never links an action. Keyed `relationship_id`; joins `regulatory_agenda_items` on `agenda_item_id`, `proceedings` on `proceeding_id` and `unified_agenda` on `rin`. Built by `build_regulatory_agenda`; all columns are VARCHAR.

properties.name: relationship_id
properties.description: Stable id of the link (`agenda_proceeding_relationship_<24 hex>`), from its RIN, proceeding, source and evidence.

properties.name: agenda_item_id
properties.description: The agenda item; joins `regulatory_agenda_items.agenda_item_id`.

properties.name: rin
properties.description: The item's Regulation Identifier Number.

properties.name: proceeding_id
properties.description: The proceeding the item tracks; joins `proceedings.proceeding_id`.

properties.name: relationship_role
properties.description: The link's role; `agenda_tracks_proceeding` throughout.

properties.name: source
properties.description: What reported the RIN: `docket_rin` (the docket), `document_rin` (a document's `additional_rins`) or `federal_register_rin` (a Register document).

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: The reporting record, by `source`: a docket id, a Regulations.gov document id, or a dated Register record id (`number@YYYY-MM-DD`).

properties.name: evidence_uri
properties.description: Public URL of that record on regulations.gov or federalregister.gov.

properties.name: evidence_date
properties.description: Eastern day of the evidence: the docket's or document's latest date, or the Register publication date.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One evidence record linking one agenda item (RIN) to one proceeding.

schema.name: comment_periods
schema.description: One rule-derived group of source-reported comment windows. Extension/reopening language links windows only when an explicit page citation or qualified RIN uniquely identifies an overlapping or adjoining earlier notice. Conflicts do not link; a gap starts another period. These are candidate groupings, not verified legal extensions. Docket/proceeding anchors never merge groups, and synthetic Federal Register feed dockets anchor none. Ordered source references support navigation.

properties.name: comment_period_id
properties.description: Stable id of the period (`comment_period_<24 hex>`), from the records that open it.

properties.name: proceeding_ids
properties.description: Native list of the proceedings its notices belong to; `[]` when none resolves. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: rins
properties.description: Native list of the RINs its records state and its proceedings hold. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: docket_ids
properties.description: Native list of the Regulations.gov dockets anchoring it: those its Register record names, else those of its copies, else a Regulations.gov notice's own; never a feed docket. `[]` where the publishers place the notice in no docket (the Register names none and no copy sits in one, as for FCC-2026-2942-0001), which is not proof that none exists. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: open_date
properties.description: Eastern day the period opens: the earliest opening among its records (a document's comment start, else its posting; a Register record's publication), `YYYY-MM-DD`.

properties.name: close_date
properties.description: Maximum non-placeholder normalized close among grouped records, YYYY-MM-DD: the later of register_close_date and regulations_gov_close_date. Not a legally controlling/current deadline or a submission-purpose classification. Search all three dates; see data_quality.

properties.name: source
properties.description: The sources of the dates it takes, `+`-joined: `documents.comment_end_date` and `federal_register.comments_close_on`.

properties.name: opened_by_artifact_ids
properties.description: Native list of public URLs of the records whose window opens the period on `open_date`. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: evidence_ids
properties.description: Native list of every record in the period, each in exactly one period: dated Register record ids (`number@date`), a notice's Register record included when only its copies state a window, and Regulations.gov document ids. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: evidence_occurrences

customProperties.value: STRUCT("source" VARCHAR, "role" VARCHAR, evidence_id VARCHAR, source_ordinal BIGINT, document_id VARCHAR, document_number VARCHAR, publication_date VARCHAR, open_date VARCHAR, close_date VARCHAR, rins VARCHAR[], rin_values_json VARCHAR)[]

properties.description: Every accepted source date window before membership lists reduce to sets. Includes source namespace, native document key, source row order, role, dates, and ordered RIN observations. A Register reference requires both document number and publication date; missing older observations remain null. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: unresolved_fr_references_json
properties.description: JSON array of unresolved Register number references attached to its evidence.

properties.name: anchor_kind
properties.description: What anchors the period: `docket` when a docket does, `proceeding` when only a proceeding does, `none` when neither; the rulespec export takes the anchored rows.

properties.name: register_close_date
properties.description: Latest `comments_close_on` of its Register records, `YYYY-MM-DD`; NULL when the Register states none.

properties.name: regulations_gov_close_date
properties.description: Latest comment end (Eastern day) of its Regulations.gov documents, `YYYY-MM-DD`; NULL when none states one.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One rule-derived group of source-reported date windows for a notice and its candidate extensions; not a legally adjudicated comment period.

schema.name: lifecycle_events
schema.description: One dated stage event per document in a docketed proceeding. A uniquely resolved Federal Register number supplies its document type and date; otherwise the Regulations.gov type and upload day apply. Only Rule/Proposed Rule types create those stages: Notice entries and withdrawn postings do not. A dated Unified Agenda withdrawal can add a withdrawal event. Main document identity and date-source fields preserve those distinctions.

properties.name: lifecycle_event_id
properties.description: Stable identity of this lifecycle event within its lifecycle.

properties.name: proceeding_id
properties.description: The proceeding; joins `rulemaking_lifecycles.proceeding_id`.

properties.name: document_id
properties.description: The document, by `dated_by`: a dated Register record id (`number@YYYY-MM-DD`), a Regulations.gov document id, or an agenda item id (`urn:rkaf:us:rin:<rin>`).

properties.name: stage
properties.description: The stage the event records: `proposed`, `supplemental`, `final` or `withdrawn`.

properties.name: event_date
properties.description: The event's day, from the source `dated_by` names.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Who typed the stage: `federal_register` (for its copies too, wherever it states a type), `regulations_gov` or `unified_agenda`.

properties.name: dated_by
properties.description: Whose day `event_date` is, and so which kind of id `document_id` is: `federal_register`, `regulations_gov` (its upload) or `unified_agenda`.

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: The proceedings stage event it came from: that record's own id, or `<agenda item id>@<edition>` for an Agenda withdrawal.

properties.name: joined_by
properties.description: How the document joined the proceeding: `docket`, `fr_docket_link`, `fr_copy`, `specific_rin` or `agenda_rin`.

properties.name: document_form
properties.description: Its stage refined by its title: `proposed`, `advance_proposed`, `comment_period`, `final`, `interim_final`, `direct_final`, `correction`, `supplemental` or `withdrawn`.

properties.name: anchor_role
properties.description: `proposal`, `final` or `withdrawal` when the lifecycle anchors on this document; NULL otherwise.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One stage event per document of one docketed proceeding.

schema.name: proceedings
schema.description: One rulemaking proceeding with its source dockets, Register documents and staged events. RINs provide agenda evidence and never merge dockets. Withdrawn Regulations.gov postings supply no event, title, agency or RIN evidence. A docket-less proceeding is one Register document. `proceeding_id` continues across generations when source records overlap; main IDs link agenda associations, comment periods and lifecycle records.

properties.name: proceeding_id
properties.description: Stable opaque id of the proceeding (`proceeding_<24 hex>`), continued from the prior generation where it overlaps one.

properties.name: rin
properties.description: The proceeding's RIN when it holds exactly one, else NULL; a query aid, never its identity (`rins` lists every RIN).

properties.name: docket_ids
properties.description: Native list of the Regulations.gov dockets the proceeding comprises; `[]` for a docket-less proceeding. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title of its most recently dated titled document.

properties.name: agency_code
properties.description: The agency code most of its documents carry. A docket-less proceeding takes its Register document's agency code. Each Register agency maps to one Regulations.gov code through RefSpec's agency projection and agency registry, whose identity bridges and successions give a defunct agency its current successor's code whatever the document's date: a 1998 Health Care Finance Administration notice is CMS. A split agency maps only when every successor gives the same one code. A department named with one of its own agencies yields to it (Transportation Department with FAA is FAA), and a department signing with one of its own unmapped bureaus keeps the department's code. NULL when no agency maps or the agencies are unrelated.

properties.name: current_stage
properties.description: The one stage (`proposed`, `supplemental`, `final` or `withdrawn`) of its latest dated events; NULL when none, or when that day's events disagree.

properties.name: stage_events

customProperties.value: STRUCT(stage VARCHAR, event_kind VARCHAR, effective_date VARCHAR, document_id VARCHAR)[]

properties.description: Native list of its stage events, one per staged document: `{effective_date, event_kind, evidence_id, joined_by, source, stage}`. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: fr_document_numbers
properties.description: Native list of the Federal Register document numbers it holds. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: cfr_refs
properties.description: Native list of the CFR references (`title-part`) that the `rule_targets` edges of its dockets name. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: cfr_target_iris
properties.description: The same CFR references as Rulespec identifiers (e.g. `urn:rkaf:us:cfr:40:60`). Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: authority_refs
properties.description: Always `[]`: legal authority belongs to the editioned Unified Agenda entry, never to an action. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: fr_document_ids
properties.description: Native list of the dated Federal Register record ids (`number@YYYY-MM-DD`) it holds. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: fr_document_joins_json
properties.description: How each `fr_document_ids` document joined, in the same order: `{fr_document_id, joined_by}`, `joined_by` being `fr_docket_link`, `fr_copy`, `specific_rin` or `fr_document`.

properties.name: unresolved_fr_references_json
properties.description: JSON array of Register number references it holds that resolve to no single record, each with its candidates and status.

properties.name: rins
properties.description: Native list of every RIN it holds, from its dockets, documents and Register documents. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One rulemaking proceeding: the dockets and Register documents that are one action.

customProperties.value: unified_agenda holds every readable edition, Fall 1995 to the newest (202510). Of the RINs no edition lists, 802 are X-pattern codes (NOAA's 0648-X in-season series and other agencies', never on the agenda; decision 61), 3,030 are well formed but unlisted, and 1 is the placeholder 0000-AA00. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.

schema.name: regulatory_agenda_items
schema.description: One row per Regulation Identifier Number: the durable Regulatory Agenda item a RIN identifies, with how many proceedings evidence links it to and whether its scope is resolved. Keyed `agenda_item_id` (`urn:rkaf:us:rin:<rin>`), one per `rin`; joined by `agenda_item_proceedings` on `agenda_item_id`, and to `unified_agenda` on `rin`. Built by `build_regulatory_agenda`.

properties.name: agenda_item_id
properties.description: The item's id, `urn:rkaf:us:rin:<rin>`.

properties.name: rin
properties.description: The Regulation Identifier Number the item is (e.g. `2060-AV16`).

properties.name: scope_status
properties.description: `recurring` (its latest Agenda priority is Routine and Frequent), `single_observed` (evidence links one proceeding) or `unresolved` (none or several).

properties.name: linked_proceeding_count
properties.description: How many proceedings `agenda_item_proceedings` links the item to, as a decimal string.

properties.name: observation_count
properties.description: How many distinct Unified Agenda entries (edition and URL) list the RIN, as a decimal string; `0` when no edition does.

properties.name: latest_agenda_edition
properties.description: The latest Unified Agenda edition listing the RIN, `YYYYMM`; NULL when no edition does.

properties.name: first_seen
properties.description: Earliest Eastern day any source dates the RIN: an Agenda edition or action date, a docket or document date, or a Register publication.

properties.name: last_seen
properties.description: Latest Eastern day any source dates the RIN.

properties.name: unresolved_fr_references_json
properties.description: JSON array of unresolved Register number references from the Register documents that state this RIN.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One durable Regulatory Agenda item per RIN.

customProperties.value: unified_agenda holds every readable edition, Fall 1995 to the newest (202510). Of the RINs no edition lists, 2,410 are X-pattern codes (NOAA's 0648-X in-season series and other agencies', never on the agenda; decision 61), 3,434 are well formed but unlisted (an item exists for every RIN any source states), and 1 is the placeholder 0000-AA00. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.

An item with no latest edition is one no edition lists. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.

schema.name: rule_targets
schema.description: One observed link between a Regulations.gov docket, a CFR part or a Unified Agenda RIN, with its source evidence class. Missing and ambiguous references remain unresolved. Action-notice citation rows can have both targets NULL. RIN navigation returns agenda editions; it does not merge proceedings. Main identifiers carry the relationship; receipts retain interpretation evidence.

properties.name: rule_target_id
properties.description: Stable identity of this rule-target assertion, preserving repeated observations independently.

properties.name: docket_id
properties.description: Regulations.gov docket the edge belongs to, normalized; joins `dockets.docket_id`.

properties.name: cfr_ref
properties.description: CFR reference the rule targets, `title-part` or `title-part.section` (e.g. `40-60`); NULL on a RIN-only or citation edge.

properties.name: cfr_title
properties.description: The CFR title of `cfr_ref` (e.g. `40`).

properties.name: cfr_part
properties.description: The CFR part of `cfr_ref` (e.g. `60`).

properties.name: cfr_section
properties.description: The CFR section of `cfr_ref` when it names one; NULL for a part-level reference.

properties.name: rin
properties.description: Regulation Identifier Number the edge carries (e.g. `2060-AV16`); NULL on a CFR-only or citation edge.

properties.name: source
properties.description: The evidence class: `fr_cfr_ref`, `docket_rin`, `document_rin`, `document_fr_doc` or `docket_document_cites_action_notice`.

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: The least id of the records stating the edge: the docket for `docket_rin`, a dated Register record id (`number@YYYY-MM-DD`) for `fr_cfr_ref`, else a Regulations.gov document id.

properties.name: first_seen
properties.description: Earliest Eastern day any evidence for the edge is dated, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

properties.name: last_seen
properties.description: Latest Eastern day any evidence for the edge is dated, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

properties.name: fr_references_json
properties.description: JSON array of the literal Federal Register number references behind the edge, each with the `status` saying how it resolved (`dated`, `single_candidate_in_input`, `ambiguous`, `missing`, or a folded or unpadded match).

properties.name: fr_document_ids
properties.description: Dated Federal Register document identities associated with this subject; no applicability inference is implied. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One observed docket, CFR and RIN edge per evidence source class.

customProperties.value: rule_targets holds part-level keys, so the join is on title and part, which a part held only as section rows also has; the printed cfr_ref missed 12 such parts (50 CFR 622 among them). cfr_sections holds the 2025 edition of every title and the 2026 edition of titles 5, 7, 9-12 and 14-16 only, so a part can be missing either way: 679 of the 799 missing keys were last cited before 2025, which fits a part removed or redesignated since; a key first cited later can name a part created after the held edition (41 CFR 105-9 and 105-10 are new in 2026) or one a proposed rule would create, which no edition holds (2 CFR 6100, 10 CFR 57, 21 CFR 1108 and 43 CFR 1700 are in no eCFR version of 2025-01-01 or 2026-09-30). Title 41 matches at chapter level only: the Federal Register cuts a compound part at the hyphen (41 CFR 60-1.4 is part 60), so 13 of its 14 Title 41 keys (chapters 50, 51, 60, 61, 101, 102, 105, 128, 201 and 300-303) name chapters, which no cfr_sections part matches once its Title 41 structural rows carry their compound parts; they are counted missing (the 14th, 41-74, names no Title 41 chapter and is among the 799). A Register reference that names a chapter and no part (FR 2026-00929, chapters 300-304) yields no edge. Measured 2026-10-03 on rule_targets snapshot_448e6d9a… and cfr_sections eab08a3f…: 6,146 keys, 799 missing, plus those 13; the same counts on snapshot_55d396ee…. Receipts mcp-chaos-2026-10-02/round4/joins-measured-2026-10-03.json and mcp-chaos-2026-10-02/round5/scout-A/m1b_rt_missing.out.
Normalized FR-to-Regulations.gov bridge from the materialized rulemaking snapshot. Each orphan is one fill-docket-gaps asked for: 16 answer 404 and 67 answer 400 Invalid ID.

unified_agenda holds every readable edition, Fall 1995 to the newest (202510). Of the RINs no edition lists, 1,269 are X-pattern codes (NOAA's 0648-X in-season series and other agencies', never on the agenda; decision 61), 1,029 are well formed but unlisted (854 first dated 1995-2025, 174 in 2026, after the newest edition, and 1 before Fall 1995), and 1 is the placeholder 0000-AA00. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.

schema.name: rulemaking_lifecycles
schema.description: One docketed proceeding's proposal-to-final history and survival outcome. The earliest Register-dated proposal takes precedence over an upload-dated proposal; the final must follow it strictly. Other events determine the outcome or censor date. Docket-less Register records cannot pair and are excluded. Unified Agenda status and routine strata remain separate context. These are docketed proceedings, not a count of distinct RINs or regulations.

properties.name: proceeding_id
properties.description: The docketed proceeding the lifecycle reads; joins `proceedings.proceeding_id`.

properties.name: agency_code
properties.description: The proceeding's agency code.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: What its events make: `finalized` (a final strictly after the proposal), `companion` (a Register-dated final on the proposal's Register day, 54b; no survival outcome), `upload_pair` (an upload-dated proposal and a final that day, 54c; no survival outcome), `withdrawn` (a Register or Agenda withdrawal on or after the proposal, no later final), `open` (censored at `censor_date`), `final_without_observed_proposal` or `no_anchor`.

properties.name: proposal_date
properties.description: Day of the earliest proposed event; NULL without a proposal.

properties.name: proposal_document_id
properties.description: The proposal's document: a dated Register record id (`number@YYYY-MM-DD`) when the Register dates a proposal of the proceeding, else a Regulations.gov document id (decision 54d).

properties.name: proposal_form
properties.description: The proposal's form from its title: `proposed`, `advance_proposed`, `comment_period` or `correction`.

properties.name: final_date
properties.description: Day of the final the lifecycle pairs or anchors on; NULL without one.

properties.name: final_document_id
properties.description: The final's document, spelled as `proposal_document_id` is.

properties.name: final_form
properties.description: The final's form from its title: `final`, `interim_final`, `direct_final` or `correction`.

properties.name: finals_before_proposal
properties.description: Finals dated before the proposal, counted and never paired; NULL without a proposal.

properties.name: withdrawal_date
properties.description: Day of the withdrawal that makes it `withdrawn`; NULL otherwise.

properties.name: withdrawal_document_id
properties.description: The withdrawal: a dated Register record id, or the agenda item id (`urn:rkaf:us:rin:<rin>`) of an Agenda withdrawal.

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: Its survival outcome: `final`, `withdrawn` (a competing outcome) or `censored`; NULL for a kind outside survival.

properties.name: duration_days
properties.description: Days from the proposal to the final, the withdrawal or `censor_date`; NULL without an outcome.

properties.name: censor_date
properties.description: The generation's last event day, capped at the run's day, where open lifecycles are censored; one date in every row.

properties.name: open_signal
properties.description: What the latest Unified Agenda entry of its specific RINs says (`agenda_completed_final`, `agenda_completed_withdrawn`, `agenda_completed_other`, `agenda_long_term`, `agenda_active`, `agenda_dropped_off`), else `not_on_agenda` or `no_specific_rin`.

properties.name: routine_family
properties.description: The routine family the proposal's own title names (the final's without a proposal; the proceeding's with no anchor), read at time zero so the stratum never depends on the outcome (decision 55a): `airworthiness_directive`, `airspace`, `state_air_plan`, `pesticide_tolerance` (pesticide-petition receipts included), `coast_guard_local`; NULL otherwise.

properties.name: agenda_priority
properties.description: That Agenda entry's `priority_category` (e.g. `Economically Significant`); NULL without one.

properties.name: agenda_major
properties.description: That Agenda entry's `major` (`Yes`, `No` or `Undetermined`); NULL without one.

properties.name: specific_rins
properties.description: Native list of the RINs the proceeding's docket-side evidence alone holds. Stored as native nested values; list order, repeated values, null and empty collections remain distinct.

properties.name: pre_2008_coverage
properties.description: Whether it is anchored before 2008, when Regulations.gov coverage is thin; NULL without an anchor, or for an upload pair from 2008 on.

customProperties.value: Agency assigned to the proceeding; preserve mapping provenance. Full selected keys and unique parent keys checked on 2026-10-06; CI checks resolution and parent uniqueness.

The final anchor is one of its proceeding's events. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.

The proposal anchor is one of its proceeding's events. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.

The withdrawal anchor is one of its proceeding's events. Measured 2026-09-27 on snapshot_f31a4045…; receipts rulemaking-exposure-2026-09-27/proposed-joins.json and join-map-2026-09-26/rulemaking-exposure-independent.json, -2.json.
